purpose: Classify canonical skills that do not have source_parallel_quests, preventing non-PQ acquisition routes from being incorrectly forced into the PQ graph.

interpretation.time_rift: Already represented through Time Rift endpoints; no PQ edge should be inferred.
interpretation.story: Already represented or explicitly story/Skill Shop acquisition; no PQ edge should be inferred.
interpretation.mentor: Mentor-training acquisition; repository currently has no canonical mentor record layer to attach stable IDs to.
interpretation.advancement_test: Already represented through advancement-test IDs where present.
interpretation.shop: Skill Shop/TP Medal/STP Medal acquisition; no PQ edge should be inferred.
interpretation.expert_mission: Expert Mission acquisition; repository currently has no canonical Expert Mission record layer to attach stable IDs to.
interpretation.character_only: Character/roster acquisition, not a CaC PQ source.
interpretation.starting: Starting/fighting-style acquisition, not a PQ source.
interpretation.wish: Shenron wish acquisition, not a PQ source.
interpretation.other: Requires targeted evidence before any cross-domain ID is created.

notes: The 71 skills are not automatically missing PQ links. The audit separates legitimate non-PQ acquisition routes from unresolved cases.
The repository's null policy requires unknown values to remain unresolved rather than guessed.
No acquisition facts were changed in this classification cycle.
